csvUrl.title: Google Sheet or CSV link
csvUrl.description: Link to a Google Sheet (sharing: 'Anyone with the link can view') or to a CSV file. The first row must contain column names, e.g. name, course, date.

csvText.title: …or paste CSV
csvText.description: Paste rows directly. First row = column names.
csvText.prefill:
name,course,date
Maria Popescu,Intro to Python,September 20 2026
John Smith,Intro to Python,September 20 2026

records.title: …or JSON records
records.description: Array of objects, e.g. [{"name": "Anna", "course": "Robotics"}]. Used before CSV if both are given.

datasetId.title: …or Apify dataset ID
datasetId.description: Use items from an existing Apify dataset (e.g. output of another Actor).

nameField.title: Name column
nameField.description: Column that holds the person's name. Rows where it is empty are skipped.

body.title: Main text
body.description: Use {{column}} to insert any column from your list, e.g. {{course}}, {{hours}}, {{grade}}.
body.default: This certificate is awarded for successfully completing {{course}}.

date.title: Date line
date.description: Fixed text or {{date}} to take it from your list.

logoUrl.title: Logo URL
logoUrl.description: Public link to a PNG/JPG/SVG logo.

addQrCode.title: Add QR verification code
addQrCode.description: Adds a QR code and certificate ID in the corner.

verifyUrlTemplate.title: QR link
verifyUrlTemplate.description: Where the QR code points, e.g. https://yourschool.com/verify?id={{certificateId}}

certificateIdPrefix.title: Certificate ID prefix
certificateIdPrefix.description: IDs become PREFIX0001, PREFIX0002… A 'certificateId' column in your list overrides this.

mergeIntoOnePdf.title: Also create one merged PDF (for printing)
mergeIntoOnePdf.description: Also create one merged PDF (for printing).

customHtml.title: Custom HTML (design = Custom)
customHtml.description:
Your own page HTML with {{column}} placeholders. {{qrDataUrl}} gives the QR image. Wrap content in
…
.

customCss.title: Custom CSS
customCss.description: Extra CSS. Fonts available: Montserrat, Playfair Display, Great Vibes, Lora.
